title: L-Lactide polymerization studied by 1 H NMR with di ff usion-ordered spectroscopy (DOSY): a ' One NMR Tube Experiment ' providing data on monomer conversion, polymer structure, M n and M w
abstract: L-Lactide polymerization was studied by a ' One NMR Tube Experiment ' . Traditional 1 H NMR, which provides structural information, conversion values, and number average molar mass ( M n), was combined with di ff usion-ordered spectroscopy (DOSY), yielding a mass averaged molar mass ( M w). Thus, a complete kinetic experiment could be performed without sampling, and hence in one NMR tube.
